scope: Persist model and tool attempt metadata and read it by the same analysis job ID across Worker replacement.
environment: Local PostgreSQL test database, real Worker processes, in-process FastAPI HTTP tests, and the real OpenAI SDK with a mock transport. Model and GitHub responses were simulated.

process_cases.interruption: SIGTERM during the saved four-second retry wait after a simulated GitHub HTTP 503
process_cases.result: The same job ID completed. Its trace retained the failed attempt, timing and saved retry time. The replacement Worker waited until that time and added a successful label retry linked to the original attempt ID.

process_cases.interruption: SIGTERM and SIGKILL in separate runs while the label tool was in flight
process_cases.result: Both jobs completed with their original job IDs. The first three trace entries matched their pre-restart values. The in-flight entry retained its ID and start time, became interrupted and kept a null duration.

offline_checks: A successful model retry links to its failed attempt and retains both measured durations.
Exhausted model and tool budgets, an exhausted retry, a wait beyond the runtime limit, and non-retryable model failures record the corresponding stop reasons.
A context limit before dispatch records a job stop with no attempt.
A timed-out attempt records its duration, and an unknown job ID returns HTTP 404.
